title: Generate a slug from a title
description: Generate stable URL slugs on the server while showing editors the value live in the Admin UI.
problem: You want readable URLs without asking editors to hand-author slugs for every document.
summary: Generate the slug on the server and optionally mirror it live in Admin so titles and URL fields stay aligned.
intents: make the URL follow the title
keep a slug synchronized with a title

title: Show an Admin field only when it is relevant
description: Use a serializable Admin condition to reveal a field from the editor's current form values.
problem: Some fields only make sense after an editor has made an earlier choice.
summary: Use an Admin condition to hide irrelevant fields until the current form state makes them useful.
intents: show discount only with a coupon
make the admin form react to another field

title: Validate related fields before saving
description: Reject invalid combinations of field values before they reach the database.
problem: A field value is only valid in relation to another field, such as a start date and an end date.
summary: Use a collection hook to reject invalid combinations before the document reaches the database.
intents: make sure an end date is after the start date

title: Update a dropdown from another field
description: Change available Admin UI options immediately when an editor changes a related field.
problem: The valid options for one field depend on what the editor picked in another field.
summary: Update select options from sibling field data so the next choice stays constrained by the current form state.
intents: make one dropdown depend on another
show states based on the selected country

title: Add draft, review, and publishing states
description: Attach Dyrected's standard editorial workflow and its capability-aware transitions to a collection.
problem: Content should move through draft and review before the right person is allowed to publish it.
summary: Attach Dyrected's editorial workflow so documents move through named states instead of going live immediately.
intents: let editors submit content for approval

title: Limit documents to their owner
description: Return a where constraint from access control so authenticated users only read their own records.
problem: Signed-in users should only see or manage the records they own.
summary: Scope reads and writes to the current user in access control, then stamp ownership when records are created.
intents: users should only see their own records
prevent users reading another user's data

title: Build flexible pages from reusable blocks
description: Define labeled hero, rich-text, and call-to-action blocks for an editor-controlled page layout.
problem: Editors need to build or rearrange page sections without turning every page into one giant content object.
summary: Use blocks to model reusable page sections inside a page layout so pages stay flexible without becoming unstructured.

title: Model a relationship and its reverse lookup
description: Store an author relationship on posts and expose the author's posts through a virtual join field.
problem: One record should point to another record, and you also want the reverse view without storing duplicate data.
summary: Store the owning relationship on one side and use a join field for the reverse lookup when you need one-to-many content structures.
intents: show every post written by a user

title: Restrict content operations by user role
description: Allow public reads, editor writes, and administrator deletion with collection access rules.
problem: Different roles should have different permissions for reading, editing, publishing, or deleting content.
summary: Check user roles in collection access control so each operation matches the responsibilities of the current user.

title: Rename a field without orphaning existing data
description: Use renameTo and a safe default while documents migrate lazily to a new field name.
problem: You need to change a field name on a live schema without breaking the documents that already exist.
summary: Use renameTo and a safe default so old data keeps working while the schema evolves toward the new field name.
intents: change a field name without losing data
keep old documents working after a rename

title: Create a media upload collection
description: Enable file uploads and capture accessible metadata in a dedicated media collection.
problem: Editors need a proper place to upload and reuse files instead of scattering media fields across unrelated documents.
summary: Create a dedicated upload collection with file rules and metadata fields so media can be managed and reused cleanly.
intents: add image uploads to my project
